BrochureContent.Content:
Dixon Residential Estate Agents proudly presents this attractive two-bedroom home to the Athy property market.

The property offers well-proportioned and versatile accommodation extending to approximately 77 sq. m. The ground floor comprises a welcoming entrance hall, a spacious living room to the front, and a bright kitchen/dining/family room to the rear providing excellent additional living space. A guest WC completes the accommodation at this level.

Upstairs, there are two well-proportioned bedrooms, including a generous primary bedroom with ample storage, along with a family bathroom and additional storage space.

The property offers excellent potential for modern living and benefits from a practical layout, generous living accommodation and a well-established residential setting. Athy provides a wide range of local amenities, including shops, schools, sporting and recreational facilities, while excellent transport links provide convenient access to surrounding towns and Dublin.

This is an excellent opportunity to acquire a well-proportioned home in a popular and established residential location. 

Early viewing is highly recommended.

In certain cases some information may have been provided by the vendor to us.
